findings_for_codex.title: claim_backer has no deliverability preflight
findings_for_codex.detail: claims.rs claim_backer credits the destination with validate_destination only (like close_shared_account, M8-F1): a dust claim to a sub-minimum fresh wallet passes the program and fails at the cluster rent rule with the credit left claimable; no loss; inconsistent with the refund path's credit_is_deliverable. Options: accept/document (recommended, mirrors M8-F1) or add the preflight (RefundNotDeliverable-style refusal).
findings_for_codex.status: DECIDED by Codex (M9 review of 9f3da9a): accept and document; no new deliverability mechanism, no cash-progress gate; no code change
findings_for_codex.decision: A dust claim to a destination the cluster rent rule would not accept (data-less, ending below the rent-exempt minimum) fails the whole transaction at the runtime; the program state is unchanged, so the credit stays claimable to a fundable destination — the same accepted limitation as page cleanup (M8-F1). Source-backed cluster rule: Agave `transition_allowed` (RentPaying post-state is allowed only without a credit); the program predicate `credit_is_deliverable` is validated against the rule text in `tests/transfer_constraints.rs`. Local execution: LiteSVM 0.7.1 skips rent-state checks for data-less accounts, so the dust claims in §3 of the measurements SUCCEED locally (`dust_claims` rows) and the cluster refusal is not observable here. Documented in `docs/solana/measurements-2026-10.md` §3 and the M9 handoff.
